constants_equal.prediction: Both constant webs have four stores, equal benefit; exact queue-key ties put the later insertion first. At every colour decision choose first eligible minimum-penalty register.

constants_plus_one.prediction: Adding one memory store raises the first constant web's benefit by one if boundaries remain equal; its refs rise by one. No claim that raw refs alone determine order.

loop_flat.prediction: Three eligible stores pool one constant; ordinary nonzero constant has benefit 3 minus materialization costs. It survives only with positive final benefit.

loop_depth.prediction: The loop-body per-use weight is 2^(loop_depth+1), not a constant times raw refs; benefit exceeds loop_flat's benefit with the same three stores.

call_dead.source:
extern void Tick();
int Test(int *p) { int x=p[0]; p[1]=x+3; Tick(); return p[1]; }
call_dead.prediction: Moving x's last use before Tick removes its call-crossing requirement. x needs no callee-saved binding across Tick; pointer p still crosses the call.

slots_decl_ba.prediction: Reversing only declarations leaves use order, reference-history stack order and a/b offsets identical to slots_ab.
